name: mycode

Eval.description: Script that is executed by passing a string to the host-provided eval function.

Function.description: Script that is executed by passing a string to the 'Function' constructor.

ScriptBlock.description: Script that is executed by passing a string to the 'setTimeout', 'setImmediate', or 'setInterval' functions.

MyCode.description: An array of urls or files that are classified as 'MyCode'.

Libraries.description: An array of urls or files that are classified as 'LibraryCode'.

Unrelated.description: An array of urls or files that are classified as 'UnrelatedCode'.

description:
Hi team,

For this build we’re classifying the three script‑execution pathways as follows: code passed to eval will be treated as **MyCode**, code instantiated via the Function constructor is considered **LibraryCode**, and any script strings used with setTimeout**, setImmediate** or setInterval are marked as **UnrelatedCode**.

The resources that fall under each category are listed below. The **MyCode** assets include the main application script at https://example.com/app/main.js and the helper module src/utils/helpers.js. The **LibraryCode** bundle pulls in React from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/react@18.2.0/umd/react.production.min.js and lodash from node_modules/lodash/lodash.js. Finally, the **UnrelatedCode** set consists of the external ad script https://ads.example.com/banner.js and the internal analytics tracker scripts/analytics/tracker.js.
